Patient report: 45-year-old woman with acute pancreatitis reports pain improved from 9/10 to 4/10. Tolerating sips of water. Nausea resolved. No vomiting x 24h.

Nursing report: Afebrile overnight. Pain controlled on oral meds.

Physical exam: VS: T 98.8 F, HR 96, BP 122/76, RR 16, SpO2 98% RA. Abdomen: mild epigastric tenderness, no guarding.

Objective:
Labs: Lipase 420 (down from 1240), WBC 10.4, Ca 9.0, Triglycerides 320.
I/O: +1200 mL.

Assessment: Acute pancreatitis, clinically improving.

Plan:
1. Acute pancreatitis, improving
- Advance to low-fat diet as tolerated
- Continue IV fluids, wean as PO intake improves
- Repeat lipase and BMP tomorrow
2. Cholelithiasis
- General surgery consulted; cholecystectomy planned after inflammation resolves
3. Hypertriglyceridemia
- Continue fenofibrate
